subject: Stream + Funcall pilot — embedding & rerank integration confirmation and next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Spencer <jordan.spencer@medifyhealth.com>, Alex Torres <atorres@medifyhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stream + Funcall pilot — embedding & rerank integration confirmation and next steps

Jordan / Alex — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap while it's fresh, plus the concrete asks we discussed so teams can align on scope and timelines. Please flag anything I missed.

High-level goals (as we heard them):
- Reduce search/triage latency for clinical query routing to <200ms P95 for top-5 hits.
- Improve result relevance using embeddings + lightweight reranking so triage accuracy increases by ~8–12%.
- Keep inference cost under the threshold you shared (~$0.015/query).

Key integration points we covered:
1) Embedding pipeline: you will stream batched document vectors to Redwood for precomputed vector store ingestion. Format: float32 / 1536-d. We recommended gzip chunking on 10k doc batches to avoid connection timeouts.
2) Rerank model: call via Redwood's reranking endpoint with candidate ids + contextual prompt. We will provide a sample structured input schema (JSON) for the ranking signal fields.
3) Streaming + Funcalls: for longer clinical summaries, your UI will use our streaming funcall path to gradually populate the KV cache and call domain-specific tools. This preserves UX responsiveness and ensures partial results while rerank is running.
4) SDK change footprint: small changes to your client: (a) add streaming websocket helper, (b) accept funcall responses and route tool calls, (c) new post-embed batching helper. We sketched a patch; attached is an initial diff (sdk-change-diff.patch).

Open technical constraints we noted:
- P95 latency target requires token streaming and aggressive prefix caching for repeated templates.
- Rerank candidates should be limited to 20 per request for cost/latency balance; we'll iterate.
- Embedded payloads must include document metadata for traceability (document_id, source, created_at).

Action items / owners (proposed):
- Aditya: circulate integration-matrix.xlsx with field-level schema and sample payloads (today).
- Priyom: draft minimal SDK patch for streaming + funcall runtime (ETA Tue 5/12).
- Laura: coordinate security questionnaire touches (data retention, KMS, logs) and share SOC2 evidence pointers (ETA Wed 5/13).
- Jordan / Alex: provide a small sample of 2–3 production documents and a representative query set (by Mon 5/11) so we can run quick perf runs.

Proposed pilot timeline: kickoff -> ingest sample -> validate embedding distance / rerank quality -> iterate on batching/quantization. Rough milestone dates in the attached integration-matrix.xlsx.

If that looks right I'll tee up a short tech huddle next week (30 minutes) so engineering can walk through the SDK diff and the example payloads.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

--
Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: integration-matrix.xlsx, sdk-change-diff.patch

From: Jordan Spencer <jordan.spencer@medifyhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Torres <atorres@medifyhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 09 May 2026 16:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Stream + Funcall pilot — embedding & rerank integration confirmation and next steps

Aditya — great summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side:

- We can extract and share 2k sample docs (redacted) by Monday. Will prioritize triage notes and discharge summaries.
- Latency target: 200ms P95 is aggressive but aligns with our product goals; we'll be open to relaxing for the first pilot if quality gains look strong.
- On candidate limits: 20 seems fine to start. What metrics should we collect on our side to validate cost/latency tradeoffs?

Also — a couple of security asks: our InfoSec will want to confirm that embeddings are encrypted at rest and that Redwood can rotate keys without re-ingesting vectors. Laura, could you add the high-level answers?

Jordan
VP Product, Medify Health
jordan.spencer@medifyhealth.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Stream + Funcall pilot — embedding & rerank integration confirmation and next steps

Looping internal owners to confirm deliverables and timeline. Quick notes from my read:

- SDK patch: I'll produce a PR that implements the streaming helper + funcall router as two focused commits. Plan: keep changes client-side only, server integration via existing endpoints. Estimate: 3 workdays.
- Perf validation: we should run two buckets — (A) full float32 embed ingestion, (B) 8-bit quantized embeddings to measure memory and I/O tradeoffs. I'll coordinate a smoke test harness.
- Telemetry: add lightweight tracing headers (x-rdwd-trace) to correlate embed -> rerank -> UI paths. That will help Jordan's team map latency end-to-end.

I'll attach a short README to the PR showing how to run local streaming mocks. Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Platform Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stream + Funcall pilot — embedding & rerank integration confirmation and next steps

Jordan / Alex — thanks for the quick turn. Short answers to your questions and next steps: 

1) Metrics to collect: request latency (client-side and server-side), token counts, candidate count per query, P95/P99, cost-per-call (we'll provide a unit cost estimate once we profile). We'll share a minimal telemetry schema by EOD.

2) Encryption / key rotation: Laura will confirm in parallel; short answer: embeddings encrypted at rest using KMS (AES-256) and we support key rotation workflows that do not require re-ingestion — we use envelope encryption and rewrap keys.

3) Pilot cadence: once we receive samples Monday, Priyom will spin the smoke tests and share initial numbers by Thursday 5/14. Aditya to schedule a 30-minute engineering sync for Tue 5/12 11:00am PT (tentative) — pls confirm availability.

Next steps (restating owners):
- Jordan / Alex: share sample docs + query set (by Mon 5/11).
- Priyom: PR for SDK + smoke test harness (by Tue 5/12).
- Laura: SOC2/key rotation confirmation + sample answers (by Wed 5/13).
- Aditya: schedule sync, share integration matrix (today).

If that matches your intent we'll proceed.

Best,
Aditya
